t: A free self-paced online course on AI literacy for K-12 educators.
steps: Find the course through NC State REPORTER.
Create a Brickyard account for registration.
Decide whether to join alone or with a cohort.
Plan time for 9 modules across the 365 days of access.
Complete the activities, self-assessments, and discussion posts for the certificate.
Ask your state or district whether CEU credit applies.
